tasks.DistinctLettersNeeded: Determine the number of distinct letters needed based on the answer choices
tasks.LetterCombinations: Calculate the number of distinct letter combinations for 2 letters (assuming 26 distinct letters)
tasks.NumberCombinations: Calculate the number of possible numbers for 2 digits
tasks.TotalCombinations: Multiply the results from tasks LetterCombinations and NumberCombinations to get total bike no's
